01 · Materials and finishes

Two grades, three finishes

We work in two grades, food-grade SS304 as standard and laboratory-grade SS316 on request, in a brushed, mirror or satin finish. Seams are welded and ground smooth, and surfaces are polished to a professional finish.

Standard

SS304 food grade

Food-grade SS304 stainless steel is our standard for kitchens: preparation tables, sinks, cabinets, shelving and racks.

On request

SS316 laboratory grade

Laboratory-grade SS316 stainless steel is available on request and suits laboratories and school science rooms.

Brushed

A visible straight grain, the usual choice for work surfaces.

Mirror

Polished to a high gloss, for decorative parts and low-contact areas.

Satin

A soft, low-sheen finish between brushed and mirror.

The swatches are illustrations. Ask to see a sample before you decide.

Kitchen systems · 01

Exhaust and fresh-air systems

A well-ventilated kitchen is essential for both safety and comfort. We design, fabricate and install exhaust hoods, ducting and fresh-air systems that remove smoke, grease and heat while keeping the air in your kitchen moving.

Two paths, one balanced kitchen

A commercial kitchen ventilation system has two paths. A heavy-duty exhaust line removes heat, smoke and grease from over the cooking line. A fresh-air supply line replaces the air being pulled out, so the kitchen does not turn into a vacuum and the air circulates across its different zones through room diffusers.

Because the two paths depend on each other, we plan the exhaust and the fresh-air supply as one system, together with your cooking line, gas line and fire suppression.

What’s included

  • Stainless-steel range hoods. SS304 hoods over your cooking line, fitted with filters, lighting and integrated switch controls.
  • Exhaust ducting and blower. Fully welded rectangular exhaust ducting powered by a centrifugal blower, with foil insulation and an access door for maintenance.
  • Fresh-air ducting and blower. Fresh-air ducting with its own blower, integrated into the hood and distributed through room diffusers.
  • Room diffusers. Square louvered diffusers that spread the fresh air across the zones of your kitchen.
  • Site assessment and layout. We assess your site, customise the system to suit your kitchen and prepare drawings.
  • Installation and commissioning. We deliver, install and commission the system on site.

The main components

A standard example

A dual-path ventilation system

One standard example from our 2026 kitchen catalogue. Every system is custom-fabricated to meet the requirements of your site.

Hood

A 4-metre SS304 stainless-steel range hood with filters, lighting and integrated switch controls.

Exhaust

A 10-metre rectangular duct of fully welded BI sheet, powered by a 3HP centrifugal blower, with foil insulation and an access door for maintenance.

Fresh air

A 15-metre GI (galvanised iron) duct system with a 3HP blower, integrated into the hood and distributed through about 8 room diffusers.

These dimensions and specifications are standard examples and are not exhaustive. All equipment can be custom-fabricated to meet your specific site requirements. Images are representative.

Kitchen systems · 02

LPG gas line installation

A centralised and safe supply of fuel to your cooking equipment. We design, fabricate and install a fully welded gas line that runs from an external gas tank farm to the appliances on your cooking line, with safety controls built in.

What’s included

  • Gas tank farm. A secured cage in an external storage area, designed to hold your gas tanks.
  • Piping network. Fully welded black iron (BI) pipes and fittings that carry the fuel into the kitchen and to your appliances.
  • Safety controls. A gas leak detection system paired with an emergency auto-shutoff valve.
  • Appliance connections. We connect your cooking equipment, such as stoves, to the gas line.
  • Testing. We test the installation to make sure there are no leaks.
  • Planned with your kitchen. The gas line is laid out with your cooking line and your exhaust system as part of one kitchen layout.

A standard example

A centralised gas line system

One standard example from our 2026 kitchen catalogue: a centralised and safe distribution of fuel to your high-pressure cooking equipment, moving from an external storage area to an internal network with built-in safety monitoring.

Gas tank farm

A secured cage designed to hold four 50 kg gas tanks.

Piping network

Fully welded BI pipes and fittings for fuel transport.

Safety controls

A gas leak detection system paired with an emergency auto-shutoff valve.

Kitchen systems · 03

Kitchen fire suppression

A wet chemical fire suppression system integrated with your range hood, designed to protect the cooking surface and the exhaust path. We supply, install and integrate it into your kitchen as part of the project.

What a system includes

  • Wet chemical tank. The tank that stores the extinguishing agent for kitchen fires.
  • Hood integration. Specialised hardware links the suppression discharge to the stainless-steel range hood.
  • Detectors. Detectors that allow the system to operate automatically.
  • Suppression line and cylinder. A suppression line and a suppression cylinder complete the layout.
  • Manual pull. A manual pull for operating the system by hand.
  • Installation and integration. We install the system and integrate it with your hood and the kitchen’s ventilation.

Diagram of possible system components: duct, detector, detector line, suppression line, cylinder and manual pull (representative).

A standard example

A wet chemical suppression system

One standard example from our 2026 kitchen catalogue: a specialised system integrated directly into the kitchen’s ventilation to deal with grease fires and high-temperature hazards.

System

A wet chemical suppression system integrated with the range hood, to provide automatic fire extinguishing. It is designed to protect the cooking surface and the exhaust path.

Agent

A 16 L wet chemical tank, the primary storage for the extinguishing agent.

Hood integration

Specialised hardware linking the suppression discharge to the SS range hood.

Components

Detectors, a suppression line, a manual pull and a suppression cylinder.
